articles.description: - Joaquín Valiente scored two second-half goals in a 2-minute span, Samuel Sarver added a stoppage-time goal and FC Dallas beat the Portland Timbers 3-0 on Saturday in Game 1 of their best-of-three series in the first round of the MLS Cup playoffs.
